# Notabenda

> Self-hosted legal pages, privacy controls and optional evidence records. Apache 2.0.

Developer preview: packages have not been published to npm. The package names are `@notabenda/core`, `@notabenda/cloudflare` and `@notabenda/authoring`. Use a trusted workspace build or locally packed tarballs. The installed CLI binaries remain `notabenda` and `notabenda-cf`. The JSON CLI and optional Markdown/MDX build API are separate.

Use the installed package documentation and types for its version. Discovery finds candidates for review; it never adds services or grants permission. Keep private reports and source archives out of public output. The host supplies backend authorization. No complete jurisdiction pack is production-supported; passing validation is not legal review.

Browse all twenty packs in five visible groups at https://notabenda.org/start/. Start with a pack job: https://notabenda.org/guide/cartridges/index.md. The installed `notabenda packs [ID ...] --json` resolves versioned jobs into the existing target contracts and relevant setup questions. `wizard --packs ID,ID --answers FILE` prepares a draft and retains the selection in its private report. Selection never proves installation, applicability or deployment verification.

## Skill

- [Notabenda integration skill](https://notabenda.org/skills/notabenda/SKILL.md): Reusable instructions for an agent integrating or updating the library.
- [Configuration target selection](https://notabenda.org/skills/notabenda/references/configuration-target.md): Match the user's requested behavior to facts, config changes, host work and acceptance scenarios.
- [Machine-readable integration reference](https://notabenda.org/integration-reference.json): Current preview targets, relevant practice-answer templates and config prerequisites. Prefer installed `notabenda describe --json` and read-only `assess` for version-matched target, authoring-shape and runtime checks. Consent controls and assessed storage exceptions are separate targets.

- [Configuration authoring schema](https://notabenda.org/site-config.schema.json): Current preview field shapes, required properties and allowed type values generated from SiteConfig. Prefer installed `notabenda schema [PATH] --json`; always run `check` for semantic rules.

## Start here

- [Compliance component map](https://notabenda.org/guide/compliance-map/index.md): What notices, choices, contract actions and evidence serve.
- [Software and storage](https://notabenda.org/guide/architecture/index.md): Build/browser/host boundaries, public assets, browser storage and optional Durable Objects.

- [Agent setup](https://notabenda.org/guide/agent-setup/index.md): Skill installation, version matching and review boundaries.
- [Package and configuration](https://notabenda.org/guide/package/index.md): Public inventory, rendering and JSON CLI.
- [Guided setup](https://notabenda.org/guide/setup/index.md): Interactive wizard and explicit noninteractive answers.
- [Services and project discovery](https://notabenda.org/guide/service-catalog/index.md): Review provider candidates and their actual use.

- [Privacy packs](https://notabenda.org/guide/privacy-packs/index.md): Direct versus indirect collection, request entry points, processing restrictions and regenerated input reviews.

## Documents and controls

- [Markdown and MDX](https://notabenda.org/guide/authoring/index.md): YAML frontmatter, trusted components and private source archives.
- [Cookie choices](https://notabenda.org/guide/consent/index.md): Connect optional service lifecycles to effective permission.
- [Terms agreements](https://notabenda.org/guide/terms/index.md): Bind an unchecked action to the exact document revision.
- [Terms framework adapters](https://notabenda.org/guide/terms/index.md#react): React provider/hooks/native control and Astro named operation-bound shell/bridge reuse the host controller. Never submit on mount; new subject/operation needs a fresh controller, and Astro also needs a new public context key. Keep uncertain-request recovery private.
- [Retained releases](https://notabenda.org/guide/releases/index.md): Keep earlier artifacts and pinned URLs through clean builds.
- [React](https://notabenda.org/guide/react/index.md): Provider, hooks and document wrappers.
- [Astro](https://notabenda.org/guide/astro/index.md): Static pages and client navigation lifecycle.

## Evidence and scope

- [Cloudflare starter](https://notabenda.org/guide/cloudflare-starter/index.md): Optional local scaffold; host-owned authorization.
- [Backend recovery rehearsal](https://notabenda.org/guide/cloudflare-recovery/index.md): Optional maintainer check using two local SQLite objects, a private KV snapshot and later retirement replay. No production restore endpoint; hosts must reconcile complete retirement and hold decisions before reopening every access path.
- [Backend API](https://notabenda.org/guide/cloudflare/index.md): Stored evidence, history and separately authorized inspection.
- [Consent evidence](https://notabenda.org/guide/consent-evidence/index.md): Notice binding, receipts and failure behavior.
- [Requirements catalog](https://notabenda.org/guide/requirements/index.md): Individual sources, applicability, caveats and implementation status.
- [Feature status](https://notabenda.org/guide/features/index.md): Implemented, partial and planned work.

## Optional

- [Browser discovery](https://notabenda.org/guide/discovery/index.md): Explicit resource/storage observations and visibility limits.
- [Technology functions](https://notabenda.org/guide/technology-collection/index.md): Prior technology disclosure, activation instructions, fresh service scope and optional on-demand controls.
- [Consent timing](https://notabenda.org/guide/regional-prompts/index.md): Explicit grant expiry and repeat-prompt policies.
- [Localization](https://notabenda.org/guide/localization/index.md): Host-supplied wording and separate jurisdiction decisions.
- [Scope and decisions](https://notabenda.org/guide/scope/index.md): Product boundaries and remaining host responsibilities.
- [Research workflow](https://notabenda.org/guide/research/index.md): Primary sources connected to requirements, implementation and tests.

- [Publication check](https://notabenda.org/guide/publication-check/index.md): Explicit Node-only observation of four pinned release files; current routes and controls remain unverified.

- [Consumer packs](https://notabenda.org/guide/consumer-packs/index.md): Five separate transaction jobs, fixed profile-language limits, manual builder inputs and the exact confirmation admission/archive dependency.

- [Specialist packs](https://notabenda.org/guide/specialist-packs/index.md): Technology declaration/consent scope, separate assessed storage objections and one document-level Google Basic adapter.

## Request-page authoring

- [Explicit request-page settings](https://notabenda.org/guide/rights-authoring/index.md): Structured setup editor, complete versioned `wizard --rights FILE` proposal and `@notabenda/core/setup/rights` API. Require actual public destinations/contact, scope, next steps, a revision and explicit `linkPrivacyToPage: true`; no rights or workflows are inferred. Page and privacy link change atomically in the local draft. Non-English native pages require complete `localization.rights` messages; the operator editor remains English. Preview destinations are inert; host intake and fulfillment remain separate.

- [Request-page localization](https://notabenda.org/guide/localization/index.md#privacy-request-pages): Complete five-field `localization.rights` visitor messages, matching locale/direction/review metadata, preserved operator facts and inert supporting preview. The English operator editor can author a non-English page only with that supplied dictionary.

- [Storage inventory authoring](https://notabenda.org/guide/storage-authoring/index.md): Complete bounded `wizard --storage FILE` batches and setup editor, with exact affected old/new owner versions. No classification, exemption, enrollment or physical cleanup is inferred. Protect assessed-exception service membership, retain previous markers and revised technology inputs separately, and keep the change review private.

- [Inspect a consent connection](https://notabenda.org/guide/connection-inspection/index.md): Explicit read-only inspection of the supplied real controller, expected compiled consent inventory and lifecycle registrations/phases. Missing callbacks differ from blocked callbacks. Publication, real effects and other packs remain unverified; keep reports private.

## Migration and release review

- [Migration and removal](https://notabenda.org/guide/migration/index.md): Preserve old restrictions, exact historical documents and pending commands while replacing loaders; removing packages is separate from erasing records.
- [Package candidate checks](https://notabenda.org/guide/release-candidate/index.md): Maintainer-only offline packing and byte-level inventory/digest report. It performs no npm publication, dependency vulnerability review or deployment acceptance.
- [Security reporting](https://notabenda.org/guide/security/index.md): Private contact and minimal synthetic reproductions for suspected vulnerabilities.
